title: Starter care, harvest and sale verified
summary: A local starter loop now supports planting, watering observation, real UTC growth, crop-specific harvests, Backpack sales and save/reopen.
changes: Backpack → Plants and harvest shows living plants, accepts watering, exposes harvest readiness and offers one-unit produce sales.
Basil and cosmos yields, sale values and the 14-day picking interval are prototype tuning. A new planting must establish before harvest, including after pickup/replant.
The garden can continue growing after harvest. The existing free Market remains free.
tests: PASS — Godot 4.6.3 care, harvest, growth, market and local vault. Coverage includes exact per-crop inventory delta, sale Rune delta, repeat harvest refusal and preserved save state.
PASS — matched OpenGL Compatibility Backpack renders reviewed.
decisions: Watering is recorded as care for the current planting. No weather, moisture or pest inference modifies growth or yield.
issues: Harvest implementations for other species and a validated plant-health model remain open.
